paragraphs: Mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 53:4, where Rabbi Nachman of Jaffa speaks in his name.
In Vayikra Rabbah 6:5, Rabbi Nechemyah and Rabbi Nachman of Jaffa report him; in Midrash Shmuel 16:1, Rabbi Menachma and Rabbi Nachman of Jaffa report him.

notes.text: דיפו means “of Jaffa,” rather than a new person or place Dipo. The different paired reporters in the three passages are preserved.

The three consulted witnesses support the direction of transmission. Vayikra Rabbah 6:5 calls Nachman of Jaffa Rav, and the Krakow Midrash Shmuel reads Menachmah. The translation follows Hyman’s wording.
